name: std::isgraph(std::locale)

declarations.code:
template <class CharT>

bool isgraph(CharT ch, const locale &loc);

intro: Checks if the given character is classified as a graphic character (i.e. printable, excluding space) by the given locale's std::ctype facet.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Returns true if the character is classified as graphic, false otherwise.

sections.title: Possible implementation

examples.output:
isgraph('⨌', C locale) returned false
isgraph('⨌', Unicode locale) returned true

summary: Checks if the given character is classified as a graphic character (i.e. printable, excluding space) by the given locale's std::ctype facet.
